scenes.title: Title card
scenes.voiceover: Spotify to MP3. Spotify links in, tagged MP3 files out.
scenes.spoken: Spotify to M P three. Spotify links in, tagged M P three files out.
scenes.onscreen: Spotify links in. Tagged MP3 files out.

scenes.title: The problem
scenes.voiceover: Want a Spotify track as an MP3 file you can keep?
scenes.spoken: Want a Spotify track as an M P three file, that you can keep?

scenes.title: Paste the link and load it
scenes.voiceover: Paste the track link and click Load. The app reads the title, artist, and length from Spotify's public pages.

scenes.title: Choose 128 kbps
scenes.voiceover: Pick a quality. One twenty-eight kilobits per second keeps files small. Files are saved to the folder shown here.

scenes.title: Download
scenes.voiceover: Click Download. The app finds a matching version on YouTube with yt-dlp, converts it to MP3 with FFmpeg, and adds the tags.
scenes.spoken: Click Download. The app finds a matching version on YouTube with Y T D L P, converts it to M P three with F F M peg, and adds the tags.

scenes.title: The tagged MP3
scenes.voiceover: And here is the file in Explorer. Named by artist and title, tagged, with the cover art.
scenes.spoken: And here is the file in Explorer. Named by artist and title, tagged, with the cover art.

scenes.title: End card
scenes.voiceover: No Spotify sign-in needed. This is an independent app, not made by Spotify. Use it only for music you may save.
